visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Sub-band of rc6. H2 'Latest news', 3-column grid of 6 story cards (image, h3 title, description, 'Learn more' text link), 'View More' load-more control (href #) and centered 'All news' pill button.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of news story cards with image on top, title, description and a text Learn more link
visualCharacteristics.description: 3-column story grid: top image, bold title, description, text 'Learn more' link; load more

contentPattern.summary: Look-alike story items in a wrapping 3-column grid; each links to a detail page and the list has a 'View More' load-more control, so it is a dynamic list -> Cards. 'View More' (href #) is behavior, not authored content.
contentPattern.structure: one row per story: cell 1 image (optionally linked), cell 2 h3 title, description paragraph and a Learn more link. With load-more, cards are revealed six at a time behind a View More button

usage.description: Latest news listing on the home page (6+ stories).

reuseGuidance: Use for story/article teaser grids. Use the base cards for generic cards.
